_note: Week of August 3–9, 2026. Back to the normal rotation — no special theme requested, so this is a Greek/Mediterranean week that brings back a couple of standing favorites: real tzatziki (hasn't been the actual sauce in a while) and pork tenderloin, both of which Jake's always liked. Wed and Fri are back to being fish nights now that there's no cost constraint. Monday's pork tenderloin makes extra for Tuesday's standing Pita Tuesday (pork + a shrimp treat, tzatziki, pita). Saturday is vegetarian (Mediterranean stuffed peppers). Sunday is standing breakfast-for-dinner — a Greek spinach, feta, and egg white scramble with pita. Laine's Tue/Thu/Sat breakfast scramble is back to feta (it was swapped to cheddar last week only to help use up that surplus). No raw onion, mushrooms, lentils, okra, or eggplant anywhere; no reheated chicken in Laine's lunch, which stays the same standing tuna jar as always.

tzatziki.name: Tzatziki
tzatziki.note: The real thing this week, not a stand-in. Classic Greek yogurt sauce with cucumber, garlic, lemon, and fresh dill — goes on Tuesday's pita as the main event, but a spoonful also works over Jake's lunch bowl, the salmon, or the stuffed peppers if there's extra. Makes about 2 cups (9 servings of ¼ cup), keeps 4–5 days. Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water first or the sauce goes watery fast.

ingredients.item: English cucumber — 1½ (150g), grated and squeezed dry

steps: Grate the cucumber, then squeeze it hard in a clean towel or cheesecloth to get as much water out as possible — this is the step that keeps the sauce thick.
Stir the drained cucumber into the Greek yogurt.
Add the garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and chopped dill. Stir to combine.
Season with salt to taste. Chill at least 30 min before serving so the flavors settle — better the next day.

dinners.name: Greek Lemon-Garlic Pork Tenderloin
dinners.note: Not a fish night, so Monday's rule is fine. Roasted pork tenderloin with potatoes and zucchini, lemon and oregano doing the work. Cook extra pork alongside for Tuesday.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 340g, Laine 200g raw (buy ~230g extra for Tuesday)
Russet potato — Jake 200g, Laine 140g, cut into wedges
Olive oil — Jake scant 2 tbsp, Laine 1¼ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss the potato wedges with half the olive oil and spice mix, roast 15 min.
Rub the pork tenderloin (both Monday's and Tuesday's extra portion, cooked together) with the remaining oil, garlic, lemon juice, and spice mix.
Add the pork and zucchini to the roasting pan with the potatoes. Roast 18–22 min more, until the pork hits 145°F internal. Rest 5 min before slicing.
Set aside the extra plain pork for Tuesday once it's cooled slightly. Jake gets the bigger portion of everything.

dinners.name: Pork & Shrimp Pita Pockets with Tzatziki
dinners.note: Standing leftovers-plus-a-treat night. Monday's reserved pork gets warmed through with a treat of pan-seared shrimp, stuffed into pita with romaine, tomato, and a generous spoonful of this week's tzatziki.

ingredients.item: Reserved pork tenderloin from Monday — Jake 180g, Laine 110g, sliced
Frozen shrimp — Jake 130g, Laine 80g raw, peeled
Whole wheat pita — Jake 1¼, Laine ¾
Tzatziki — Jake 1¼ servings, Laine scant 1 serving (see recipe card)
Olive oil — Jake scant 1 tbsp, Laine ½ tbsp

steps: Warm the sliced pork through in a skillet with a little olive oil.
In the same pan, sear the shrimp with garlic and spice mix, 2–3 min per side until just pink and opaque.
Warm the pitas. Split and fill with pork, shrimp, romaine, and cherry tomato.
Finish with a generous spoonful of tzatziki. Jake gets the bigger pita and more filling.

dinners.name: Baked Lemon-Dill Salmon, Quinoa & Broccoli
dinners.note: Back to a normal fish night. Simple baked salmon with fresh dill and lemon, quinoa, and steamed broccoli.

ingredients.item: Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine scant ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Pat the salmon dry, place on a lined sheet pan. Rub with olive oil, garlic, and lemon juice, top with the fresh dill.
Bake 12–15 min until it flakes easily. Steam the broccoli alongside.
Plate quinoa, salmon, and broccoli together. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Lemon-Garlic Chicken with Farro, Zucchini & Walnuts
dinners.note: Free night. Seared chicken over farro and zucchini, finished with toasted walnuts for crunch.

ingredients.item: Olive oil — Jake scant 1½ tbsp, Laine scant 1 tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp
Walnuts, toasted — Jake ½oz (~7 halves), Laine ¼oz, chopped

steps: Cook the farro according to package directions.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan 2–3 min until fragrant, set aside.
Season the chicken with the spice mix. Sear in olive oil 6–7 min per side until cooked through. Rest 5 min, slice.
In the same pan, sauté the zucchini and garlic 3–4 min. Toss with the farro and lemon juice.
Plate farro and zucchini, top with sliced chicken and the toasted walnuts. Jake gets more of everything.

dinners.name: Garlic Shrimp, Cod & White Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Second fish night. Shrimp and cod together with cannellini beans and cherry tomatoes over a little rice — the beans add some heft and fiber alongside the fish.

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 120g, Laine 85g raw, peeled
Cannellini beans — Jake ¼ can+, Laine scant ¼ can, rinsed
Olive oil — Jake scant 1¼ tbsp, Laine scant 1 tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp

steps: Cook the rice separately.
Pat the cod dry and season. Sear in olive oil 3–4 min per side until just cooked through, remove.
In the same pan, add the shrimp and garlic, cook 2–3 min until pink. Add the cherry tomatoes and cannellini beans, cook 2–3 min more.
Flake the cod back in gently. Season with lemon juice and spice mix. Serve over rice. Jake gets more of everything.

dinners.name: Mediterranean Stuffed Bell Peppers
dinners.note: Vegetarian night. Rice, garbanzo beans, feta, and tomato stuffed into roasted bell peppers, finished with a dollop of Greek yogurt.

ingredients.item: Bell pepper — Jake 200g (2 large, halved), Laine 160g (1½ large)
Garbanzo beans — Jake scant ½ can, Laine ⅓ can, rinsed
Feta cheese, reduced fat — Jake ⅔ cup (60g), Laine ½ cup (48g)
Diced tomatoes (canned) — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Olive oil — Jake scant 1 tbsp, Laine ½ tbsp
Greek yogurt (plain nonfat) — Jake ~2¾ tbsp, Laine ~2 tbsp, to top

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Halve the peppers and remove seeds, brush lightly with olive oil, roast 12–15 min to soften.
Cook the rice. Warm the garbanzo beans with the diced tomatoes, garlic, and spice mix.
Fold in the rice and most of the feta. Spoon the filling into the roasted pepper halves.
Return to the oven 8–10 min until heated through. Top with a dollop of Greek yogurt and the remaining feta. Jake gets the bigger peppers and more filling.

dinners.name: Greek Spinach, Feta & Egg White Scramble with Pita
dinners.note: Standing breakfast-for-dinner. A Greek-style scramble — spinach and feta, warm pita on the side.

ingredients.item: Liquid egg whites — Jake scant ⅔ cup, Laine ⅓ cup
Feta cheese, reduced fat — Jake scant ½ cup (48g), Laine ⅓ cup (36g)
Whole wheat pita — Jake 1, Laine ¾
Olive oil — Jake scant 1 tbsp, Laine ½ tbsp

steps: Wilt the spinach and garlic in olive oil, 2 min. Push to one side.
Beat the eggs and egg whites together, pour into the pan. Scramble gently over medium-low until just set.
Fold the spinach through, crumble in the feta, season with spice mix.
Warm the pita and serve alongside. Jake gets the bigger portion.

jakeLunch.name: Greek Chicken & Rice Bowl with Feta & Olives
jakeLunch.note: Sunday-batch, 5 containers, no fish (office-friendly). Chicken and rice batch-cooked, feta and olives added after reheating so they stay distinct, with a spoonful of extra tzatziki drizzled on top if there's any left from Tuesday's batch.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — ~3 lbs total (280g raw per container)
Feta cheese, reduced fat — ~2 tbsp (33g) per container
Tzatziki — ½ serving per container, if extra is on hand

steps: Cook all the rice at once. Season the chicken with the spice mix and garlic, sear or grill in batches, ~6–7 min per side until 165°F. Rest, then slice.
Roast the bell pepper (or sear it) until just tender.
Divide into 5 containers: rice, chicken, roasted pepper.
To eat: reheat, then top with feta, olives, and a drizzle of olive oil (and tzatziki if you have it) after — keeps the feta from going stringy in the microwave.

laineLunch.name: Cold Tuna & Black Bean Mason Jar
laineLunch.note: Standing cold format, unchanged again this week — same as always.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Olive oil + lemon juice, kept separate and added just before eating.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Black beans — ~¼ can per jar, rinsed
Avocado — ½ avocado per jar, added fresh when eating
Olive oil — 1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)
Lemon juice — scant ½ tbsp per jar

steps: Drain tuna, rinse black beans. Dice cucumber and bell pepper.
Layer each jar: black beans → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper.
Portion the olive oil + lemon juice dressing into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: add dressing and fresh-cut avocado, stir, eat straight from the jar.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Spinach & Feta Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Back to feta this week — the cheddar swap last week was only to help use up that surplus.

ingredients.item: Pinch oregano, thyme, cumin, paprika, salt

steps: Sauté cherry tomatoes 1–2 min in a dry nonstick pan until they start to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with feta and a pinch of spice mix.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Standing Sunday-morning waffles — separate from Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner, unchanged as always.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix batter: mix + egg whites + water per package. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.

laineSnacks.name: Banana + Greek Yogurt
laineSnacks.desc: 1 banana + 1 Oikos Triple Zero. Potassium + calcium snack.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ¾ cucumber sliced + hummus for dipping.

laineSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas
laineSnacks.desc: ¼ cup crunchy roasted chickpeas. Fiber + plant protein, lightly spiced.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

ingredients.item: Cheddar cheese, shredded — generous ¼ cup (or a sliced chunk)

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Banana
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup cottage cheese + 1 banana. High protein, calcium + potassium.

jakeSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: ¼ cup roasted chickpeas + a small handful of almonds.

jakeSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 container plain Greek yogurt + a small handful of almonds. High-protein pick.
